text:
Kira (People Ops): Quick heads-up for teams — we're running a structured evidence upload schedule for SOC2/ISO next week to avoid the last-minute dump. Slots are 2-hour windows; there's a vendor/contractor lane and a small-exception lane. Please sign up by EOD today. :spiral_calendar:

Omar (Compliance): TL;DR: upload in your assigned window, include the metadata checklist, and name files like `teamname_evidenceType_YYYYMMDD`. Missing items must be flagged with owner + ETA.

Lena (Eng): How are slots assigned? My team has two engineers OOO Tue afternoon.

Kira (People Ops): We'll auto-schedule based on team headcount and timezone. If you have hard constraints, add a note on the sign-up sheet and choose "special-handling" — we'll move you to a different slot.

Sam (Infra): I'll cover infra uploads Tue 10:00-12:00 and help with any revokes. :+1:

Maya (Vendor Ops): Vendors/contractors: use the vendor-lane form. Required: contract with security addendum, data flow diagram, and signed DPIA if applicable. No raw logs with PII.

Ravi (Legal): Reminder — redactions must be documented. If a vendor claims data can't be redacted, escalate to Legal and Compliance before uploading.

Omar (Compliance): Required evidence checklist (minimum):
```
- IAM screenshots (groups/roles, last activity)
- Change management exports (tickets linked to service names)
- Deployment runbooks and rollback steps (PDF)
- Vendor contracts with security addendum (signed PDF)
- Retention policy excerpt and sample deletion log
- Privacy training attestations (CSV of names + completion date)
```
If an item is missing, mark it "missing-evidence" in the form and assign an owner + ETA. We will triage all missing flags within 48 hours.

Kira (People Ops): Upload flow: sign-up doc -> you get a presigned URL to private S3 -> form submits metadata. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/teams/compliance/evidence-upload (SSO required).

DevBot: Automated reminders will ping 24h and 2h before each slot. React with :bell: to opt into additional reminders.

Lena (Eng): If we upload the wrong file, can it be removed?

Sam (Infra): Yes — tag me and I can revoke the presigned URL and re-issue within ~15 minutes. If it's sensitive, also message Legal.

Kira (People Ops): Exceptions process: choose "exception-request" on the form, provide a justification and ETA. Compliance will review within 48 hours.

Maya (Vendor Ops): For contractor artifacts: redact all PII, remove IPs and usernames. Use the redaction checklist in the vendor form before upload.

Omar (Compliance): Final deadline: Friday EOD for the sprint. Items still missing after the deadline will need a formal attestation exception and may delay scope acceptance.

Kira (People Ops): Action items for leads: assign your team's slot in the sign-up doc by EOD today. Ping Omar or me if you need help. We'll run a 30m QA sweep Wed 3pm to spot-check uploads; if you want a pre-upload review, ping #eng-qa.

Sam (Infra): I'll monitor infra lane on Tue 10-12 and help revoke/replace bad uploads.

Lena (Eng): Added our slot and requested special-handling for Tue afternoon conflict.

Maya (Vendor Ops): Tagging known vendors and sending vendor-lane instructions now.

Ravi (Legal): I'll be available for quick redaction escalations Thurs morning.

DevBot: Reminder scheduled for 24h and 2h before each slot.

Omar (Compliance): Thanks team — this process reduced friction in the pilot. If you see ambiguous checklist items, escalate early.

Kira (People Ops): Appreciate everyone coordinating. :pray:
